title: Dudo Error Envelope
description: The one error shape returned by every Dudo API, internal and public alike. This schema is a transcription of API_STANDARD.md §8 into a machine-readable form; it introduces no new decision and no new code. It is platform-wide rather than App-owned because an error shape that varies per module is not a shape. NOT EXECUTED: no JSON Schema implementation exists in this repository (AS1, TS1), so this document is normative and hand-checked, not machine-validated.

message.description: For a developer. NEVER contains business data, another tenant's identifiers, a stack trace, a query, a hostname, a library version, or internal structure (API_STANDARD.md §8, SECURITY_STANDARD.md §7). For a given code and a given failing condition the message is a fixed string that does not vary with the data involved — a message that varies with the record is a disclosure channel.

details.description: Machine-readable detail, under the same restriction as 'message'. Names the offending field and a stable issue token; never the offending value.

field.description: The request field, in wire form (snake_case), optionally dotted for nesting.

issue.description: A stable machine token, e.g. must_not_be_blank. Not a sentence, not the rejected value.

request_id.description: Returned on every response, success or error. It is what makes a support conversation possible without asking a customer to share their data (API_STANDARD.md §11). It is the ONLY identifier an error message carries — never a tenant id, never a resource id (MULTITENANCY_STANDARD.md §4 carrier 11).

errorCode.description: The closed taxonomy from API_STANDARD.md §8. An Action declares the subset it may return; anything outside that subset is a defect in the Action, not a new code.
